content.text: Really common at Milo's age, and it's fixable. Tonight, tell Milo the plan at bedtime, calmly and ahead of time: "If you wake up, you stay in your bed, and I'll walk you back." Then when they show up at your bed, take them back with as little talk as you can manage, every time. A sticker chart for staying in their own bed can help too. The boring, same-every-time return is what does the work.
